name: Capacity Bound for Six One-Hole Pieces with Two Largest Supports
statement: For a protected cover with six pieces, if two supports have size five, then every other support has size at least three and the sum of the protected-interior sizes is at least 82. In particular the rank multiset $(5,5,4,2,2,2)$ is impossible.
proof: A rank-$r$ piece protects $f(r)=2^r-r-1$ concepts. The permutation structure on the four-element common core has moved-set size two, three, or four. The corresponding minimum rank profiles give respectively $2f(5)+2f(3)+2f(4)=82$, $3f(5)+3f(3)=90$, and $2f(5)+4f(4)=96$.
comments: This bounds the sum of protected interior sizes; overlaps mean it is not a lower bound on the order of the union, and it is not a pc-minimality criterion.
